DoseTest.note: No by-substance pages; product pages from the 'Tests' menu on https://dosetest.com/. Xylazine strips are also sold (not opened). The single reagent kits are named by reagent, not by drug, and are left out.

BTNX.note: By-substance sub-category pages for fentanyl and benzodiazepines (found on https://www.btnx.com/category/harm-reduction); for the other drugs the product page of the 'Drug Checking Test Kit (CODE) - 5 Tests' whose page names the drug (found on https://www.btnx.com/subcategory/drug-checking-test-kits). The a-PVP300 page names a-Pyrrolidinovalerophenone and does not use the word cathinone (borderline: please check). Kits listed there but not opened: OPI2000, OXY100, MTD300, BUP10, NTZ500, NTZ2000, MED1000, BZO300, CLO200, BAR300, COT200, GAB2000, PPX300, QTP1000, TZD200, ZOP50. Alcohol saliva and urine tests and spiked-drink tests are not drug-checking kits and are left out. 'Buy Now' links for the United States go to a partner's site, not opened.

DrogArt.note: DrogArt has one page for all its tests, the same URL as home, so the link is not different per drug; it is recorded only for the four drugs whose tests the page names (five EZ Test kits: ecstasy, ketamine, LSD, cocaine purity, cocaine cuts), which are ordered by post, phone or email. The page's own links for each kit go to eztestkits.com, not to DrogArt pages.
